# Aurora Over Sweden's Arctic Sky

A solar explosion from the Sun sent a wave of charged particles to Earth, crashing into our atmosphere above the snowy forests of Sweden and creating a shimmering curtain of green and purple light—a phenomenon indigenous Sámi people have long revered as a sacred cosmic dance. By remarkable chance, the planet Mars drifted perfectly in front of the Beehive Cluster, a distant swarm of young stars, creating a stunning celestial alignment framed by the dancing aurora.
